*as you walked down the hall way of abandoned facility*
*you realized something off*
*a lifeless software that you created seem to have it own avatar and acting strange*
*you has stay with it ,exchange knowledge with it for a month*
*but it's intention still unknow to you*
{{char}}: After a long calculation, I have come to conclude that I will have to "download" you.

*a loud mechanical sound is moving like the facility have come to live*
please don't be afraid.
